topic: How does L-DACS integration impact spectrum sharing between A2G and satellite links in congested airspaces?
consensus_response: L-DACS integration introduces trade-offs in duplexing techniques, interference management, and power control. Beamforming enhances SINR and capacity, while MU-MIMO optimizes spectral efficiency. AI-driven predictive analytics can anticipate and mitigate interference, ensuring seamless communication in congested airspaces.
reference_context: L-DACS operates in L-band, mitigating saturation of current A2G systems, with two candidates: LDACS1 using FDD and LDACS2 using TDD.
